@graph.name: Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR)
@graph.description: An optional travel insurance upgrade from Travel Guard. CFAR lets you cancel your trip for any reason not otherwise covered by your base plan and receive reimbursement of a percentage of your prepaid, non-refundable trip costs. Must be purchased within a set window (typically 15 days) of your initial trip deposit and you must cancel at least 48 hours prior to departure.

audience.audienceType: Travelers who want maximum cancellation flexibility, including those concerned about events not listed as covered reasons under standard travel insurance.

priceSpecification.description: CFAR is an optional upgrade added to a base Travel Guard plan. The upgrade cost varies by plan, trip cost, and traveler age. Get a personalized quote.

mainEntity.name: Can I add Cancel for Any Reason coverage to my existing Travel Guard travel insurance plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cancel for Any Reason coverage can only be purchased at the time you purchase your base plan and only within 15 days of your initial trip payment.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Trip Cancellation and Cancel for Any Reason coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text: With Travel Guard’s Trip Cancellation coverage there are specific reasons for cancelling a trip that provide coverage . If the reason for cancelling your trip falls outside of those covered reasons you wouldn’t have coverage. Cancel for Any Reason does not have exclusions, so you are able to cancel no matter the reason. However, with Cancel for Any Reason you’ll only get a percent of your travel investment reimbursed – but that’s better than nothing!

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel my trip last minute with Cancel for Any Reason coverage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your trip must be cancelled at least two days prior to your departure date in order to use the Cancel for Any Reason coverage.
